messages:
sophia-peopleops: FYI Marco starts next Monday. He's remotely located in ITA (Milan). Background check cleared but his passport name uses an accent and our systems trimmed it. Need I-9-equivalent plan for remote start, device ship, and benefits onboarding. Quick ideas?

nate-recruiter: Candidate can provide passport scan + signed statement confirming legal name with diacritics. He prefers not to wait for embassy notary.

sec-bot: Policy: we can accept passport scan + recorded live verification as a stopgap. Require original notarized document within 7 business days. Create security exception SEC-2026-301 and attach artifacts. No access to prod until exception closed.

it-support-bot: Device request queued: Surface Laptop 4. Provisioning 48h. Shipping to ITA hub ~3 business days. If we ship Express, ETA 3bd total. Will add MDM hold flag until ID verified.

customs-vendor: Note on customs for ITA: label as "temporary export" can trigger VAT. Best to set value 0 and include company letter. If duties applied we reimburse. We recommend DHL Express.

marco-newhire: Happy to do recorded video verify tomorrow 09:00 CET. I can courier notarized passport to HQ within a week. Reimburse notary/courier fees?

sophia-peopleops: Yes we reimburse ONB-INTL. Nate I'll send Marco the remote-exception template and secure upload link. IT: hold full SSO until the notarized original arrives; guest Slack access okay after recorded verify.

nate-recruiter: Sent docs and scheduled video verify 09:00 CET tomorrow. Included instructions: upload passport scan to secure portal, attend 15-min recorded call, ship notarized original within 7bd.

it-support-bot: Guest Slack created for Marco with limited channels (welcome, team-intro). Full email/SSO will be enabled after security marks SEC-2026-301 resolved. Tracking will be posted when shipped.

sec-bot: Exception ticket SEC-2026-301 created. Reminder: attach passport scan, recorded call file, and courier tracking to close.

sophia-peopleops: Great. Closing loop: Marco does video verify tomorrow; IT queues device and adds MDM hold; customs vendor advises DHL + CN23 value 0; security exception open; reimbursements under ONB-INTL. Will follow up with shipping ETA in this thread.
